facts.fact: The African Development Bank committed US$33.9 million in 2019 (US$18.2 million disbursed by the record) for installing and commissioning 1,510 km of optical fibre in Niger and Chad under the Trans-Saharan backbone project, with five sections in Niger and one in Chad; the record's year is 2019 and it ends in 2026.
